text.text: Six questions within one configuration model
How the model organizes relationships; not a fixed verdict about you.
Driver positions within the model; present priorities need current observation.
Capability roles proposed by the model, not proof of skills or resources in life.
Questions worth examining, not a claim that you are currently in conflict.
Context and environment-response positions within the model; actual circumstances remain separate.
A question about change and what remains open. This diagram does not determine your present phase or predict events.
Structure explanation only. No personal values, causal arrows or prediction scores are shown. These editorial lenses do not replace the canonical ECR coordinate system.
Missing, unsupported or unresolved items stay visible
Example status language, not your current result. AVAILABLE · PARTIAL · UNAVAILABLE · NOT REVIEWED · UNKNOWN are normal product states—not failure states. Empty and unresolved items remain visible.
Traces support, limit or contradict claims.
Methods map limited information into structured models.
Evidence and projections are organized into a bounded reading.
Meaning is formed within source, context and evidence boundaries.
Authority, ethics and responsibility constrain the reading.
Reading stops before decision authority begins.
UNKNOWN and VERSION / REVISION remain boundaries across every layer. Reading stops before decision authority begins.
同一构型模型中的六个问题
模型如何组织关系，而不是对你的固定判决。
模型中的驱动力位置；当下的优先事项需要现实观察。
模型提出的能力角色，不证明现实中已具备的技能或资源。
值得检查的问题，不据此宣称你目前正处于冲突。
模型中的背景与环境回应位置；真实处境仍需另行核对。
关于变化与未确定事项的问题；本图不判定你的当前阶段，也不预测事件。
这里只说明结构，不显示个人数值、因果箭头或预测分数。这些介绍视角不会替代规范 ECR 坐标体系。
仅在来源支持时显示解释
仅在已建立时显示时间敏感层
你的真实经历观察保持独立
缺失、不支持或未解决的事项保持可见
这是状态语言示意，不是你当前的结果。可用、部分可用、不可用、尚未复核与未知都是正常产品状态，并不等于错误。空白及未解决的事项保持可见。
现实留下可观察的痕迹。
痕迹可以支持、限制或反驳判断。
方法把有限信息映射成结构化模型。
证据与投影被组织成有边界的读取。
意义在来源、情境与证据边界内形成。
权威、伦理与责任限制读取可以走多远。
读取在行动决定权之前停止。
未知与版本／修订贯穿每一层边界。读取在行动决定权之前停止。
